title: fix: run rootless fuse-overlayfs in its own systemd scope
body:
When rootless Podman runs inside a systemd service (such as a Quadlet) and mounts storage using `fuse-overlayfs`, the `fuse-overlayfs` daemon is started inside the first container's service cgroup. When that first container stops, systemd cleans up the service cgroup and kills `fuse-overlayfs`—breaking any other running containers that share the same mount.

This PR moves the `fuse-overlayfs` process into its own dedicated transient systemd scope under `user.slice` so its lifecycle is independent of the container service that initially triggered the mount.

ALso, `common/pkg/systemd` was left untouched in this PR

Fixes : https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/27331
### What this PR does

1. **`storage/pkg/systemd`**: Adds a helper package to create transient systemd scopes under `user.slice` (or move a process into an existing scope).
2. **`mount.go` & `overlay.go`**: Moves the rootless `mount_program` (`fuse-overlayfs`) into its own `fuse-overlayfs-<rand>.scope` under `user.slice` via `reexec` before executing `fuse-overlayfs`.
3. **`overlay_test.go`**: Adds unit test coverage for running the mount program under a systemd scope.

For Context : 
1. https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29808

comments.body:
> I really have no opinion on _whether_ we should do this, deep in the overlay driver — and that’s the more important discussion.
> 
> Just some early comments on the mechanism; I didn’t read this in detail.

I think not.  Setting up a new cgroup has a cost, and in the worse case we will end up for two scopes for each container.

It can't be part of the container cgroup because a fuse-overlays mount could be reused by different processes.

Since we already a cgroup for the pause process, I think we could reuse that.

> Since we already a cgroup for the pause process, I think we could reuse that.

@giuseppe The reason I didn't reuse the pause process cgroup here was from the earlier discussion with @Luap99 on https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29808#issuecomment-6273330560 —
  specifically that with PODMAN_NO_PAUSE_PROCESS=1, there is no pause process ig, so there wouldn't be a pause cgroup to reuse.

 To avoid creating a new scope for every mount, could we instead reuse a single shared `fuse-overlayfs.scope` for all mounts, or could you please clarify what we can do here?
